articles.summary: Headless CMS promised freedom but delivered complexity, hidden costs, and greater developer dependency. Instead of empowering marketers, it slowed them down. This article exposes the pitfalls of headless CMS and introduces a better way forward—flexible, scalable, and truly marketer-friendly content management.
articles.title: Headless CMS: The Hype, The Reality, The Mis-Sold Dream | Webiny
